> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Please target the `dev` branch instead of `main`.**
>
> DMK supports multiple keyboard models and hardware revisions, including different HHKB variants. The maintainer does not have access to every supported variant, so changes need testing by community members on real hardware before they can be considered for release.
>
> The `dev` branch is used for integration and community testing. Changes should reach `main` only after sufficient validation.
